q: Can a virtual power purchase agreement lower our Scope 2 in India?
title: Virtual PPA and Scope 2
short: Only through the certificates it transfers. A virtual PPA is a financial contract: no power flows to you. Under the GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance, a market based claim needs the renewable attributes delivered and retired for you. Open access and green tariffs are more common in India.

ul: Renewable energy certificates retired in your name, matched to your consumption period.
A contract that settles only money, with no certificates, does not change Scope 2.

p: Your location based figure stays at the grid factor whatever you buy.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
